scope: Local engineering qualification, not behavioral or phenotype findings.
other_checks: Render/tokenize only: Unicode/empty input, synthetic 51-message history, and oversize rejection for both recipients. No generation for these.
history: One AB RF trajectory: 30 full + 10 recent-three + 10 restored actual history.
recovery: Save response 25, stop before commit, resume in a fresh process for 25 new calls.
sampling: Proposed common settings, thinking off; 512 output tokens. 15-minute residency is an operational setting.
cache_policy: Ollama native cache_prompt=true; record cached tokens. No cache-equivalence claim.
scope_limits: Rendered/tokenized preflight and actual generation token counts, not raw generation input-token captures or final sampler telemetry.
One directed AB trajectory does not qualify all factorial cells or the task-free scientific prompt.
